title: A Suggestion: New Animals
body: I know the Bird is the representative animal, and I really like it, but I think it would be nice to have other animals too (hedgehog, Bunny, Cat, Dog…), just like there are different pets. They could be unlocked by completing goals, buying them with rainbow stones, hatching eggs, reaching certain streak milestone, or by purchasing body parts and features the same way colors are bought, such as different body types, ears, fur, and other customization.
author: Niicko💜

title: Increíble
body: Esta es la tercera mejor app q he usado en toda mi vida. Amo esta app, y eso q ni siquiera llevo una semana usándola. Todos los días me meto para cumplir la racha y las actividades. Esta increíble. Amo esta app

title: Really nice 🩷
body: I love it. Not only did it help me develop a good habit and routine, but it also helped me a lot. I had to start using a cane for health reasons, and it was something that made me feel very insecure and bad. But the same day I discovered it, a small cane appeared in my penguin's store. That small detail made me feel supported. Thank you so much, Finch.
